how_its_made:
WUW is a Frames that interact with Feed, Quest, and Ads through WUWFi. (Keep building after the hackathon, starting building a Farcaster client soon).

This project is built with FramesJS, and Pinata SDK.
FrameJs for flexibility and ease of use to build Frames.
Pinata SDK to easily get data for the Quest, Ads, Feeds, Channel, Cast, and Analytics of Frames.

Database: Redis cache, MongoDB with Prisma.
